name: Bybit linear BTCUSDT perpetual level-two book levels
description: Flattened absolute price levels from the Bybit v5 linear orderbook.50.BTCUSDT snapshot and delta pushes on the USDT-perpetual socket, pushed at a documented 20 ms cadence for the 50-level tier. Field-for-field identical to bybit.spot.btcusdt.book-levels, so one parser and one book reducer serve both markets and the perp/spot comparison is like for like. Rows sharing update_group form one atomic source message and must be applied in update_index order; update_count states the complete set; size zero removes a level and book reconstruction is the consumer's job. update_kind is the provider type field, validated before any empty-message short circuit. update_id is the provider u: a snapshot always reseeds this topic's cursor regardless of u, a delta with u equal to the cursor is a Duplicate and one below it is OutOfOrder, both skipped without an event; u equal to 1 on a snapshot signals a book-service restart and on a delta voids the local book and awaits a fresh snapshot. Bybit does not document u as gapless, so no jump guard is applied until the observed-contract profile justifies one. The 50-level topic keeps its own cursor, independent of every spot depth. event_time prefers the provider cts matching-engine timestamp (event_time_basis source) and falls back to the local receipt time (receipt) when cts is absent; the envelope send time ts is never used as a receipt time. expected_heartbeat_ms is 20000, a cadence bound: the venue pushes this surface at least every 20 s, so a longer silence is genuine staleness. Rights-gated: the Bybit row in knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md is unverified and the lane refuses to start unless SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES lists bybit.
